'''Blaise''' was an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] and interrogator active during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a reputation of being very ruthless in his interrogations.

==Biography==
[[File:StormCommandoDetonator-AoROS.png|thumb|left|200px|Agent Blaise triggering an explosion with a remote [[Detonator/Legends|detonator]].]]
At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Blaise and his forces proceeded to infiltrate [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], knowing that [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was secretly aiding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and was trying to rout out Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spies]] in the area.

==Personality and traits==
He was as much of a dangerously cunning warrior as he was a brutal interrogator. He also tended to note his enemies' attack patterns. Even though he was a member of the ISB instead of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], he nonetheless wore a variation of [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] [[Scout trooper armor/Legends|armor]] that had a slight blue tint to it.

==Behind the scenes==
'''Blaise''' is a character that was introduced in one of the Villain Packs of the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]''.
